name: Cold-start wind-solar benchmark
description: Reproducible reference implementation and evaluation base for the cold-start wind-solar forecasting-to-dispatch chain: data assembly, dual-structured-attention feature screening, point forecasting, probabilistic forecasting (post-hoc error-density and end-to-end implicit-quantile families), autoencoder-constrained scenario generation, scenario reduction, a temporal-structure diagnostic with a reference anchor, and a stochastic day-ahead dispatch backtest with two objective variants that differ only in the objective. The pipeline runs end to end from public data and documents every layer, its parameters and its verification criteria. This record contains code and metadata only. It ships no large data files: the two HDF5 data packages that the pipeline reads are not part of this deposit. The data packages will be published separately on Mendeley Data. Their DOI is not available yet. Once that deposit is live, the DOI will be added to this record as a related identifier from a new version of the record. Either one of the two packages is sufficient to run the pipeline, and the two are mutually convertible with the tools included here.
